coverage_notes:
[credit-cards-major] Completeness check: every issuer (non-credit-union) that filed consumer card agreements in the CFPB Credit Card Agreement Database 2025_Q2 bulk archive (705 issuers total) and the 2026_Q2 archive (562 issuers) is represented — either as a detailed/hub entry or as a CFPB-roster entry (149 roster entries; websites for ~127 matched via FDIC BankFind or known domains). Credit-union card issuers in the CFPB archive (~420) are intentionally NOT duplicated here except Navy Federal and PenFed; card bills for credit-union cards are paid through the credit union (see the credit-union category) or, for many small CUs/banks, through Elan 'Cardmember Service' (myaccountaccess.com) — covered by the Elan entry. A 114-entry co-brand/store-card map ties the names seniors actually see on their cards (AARP, Costco, Delta, United, Southwest, Marriott, Hilton, American Airlines, Amazon, Walmart/OnePay, Sam's Club, Target Circle, Kohl's, Macy's, Home Depot, Lowe's, Best Buy, JCPenney, CareCredit, gas cards, cruise lines, apparel/jewelry store cards) to the issuer entry holding the pay/autopay/statement links. Link depth: fully documented help pages (view bill, pay, autopay set up and cancel, statements, phone, mail address) were verified by fetching this session for American Express, Capital One, Bank of America, Barclays, Credit One, Regions, CFNA, Apple Card; partial for Chase (no public pay-by-phone number or mail address), Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, Synchrony, TD, Navy Federal, Bread Financial, Discover (moving to Capital One), Upgrade, Petal. Known limitations: Citi, Truist, Merrick and Fifth Third help centers are JavaScript apps with no crawlable text; PNC, KeyBank, BMO timed out; USAA, PenFed, Huntington, Mission Lane, Milestone, Indigo, Destiny, First PREMIER card servicing, Kohl's, Macy's, Home Depot, Lowe's returned bot-protection 403s. Those entries hold only verified hub/website data and need a browser-based pass. The web search budget for the session was already exhausted, so discovery relied on sitemaps, link extraction and WebFetch. SECOND REVIEW (2026-09-29): Re-fetched help/contact pages for 30+ issuer entries (Amex, Chase, Capital One, Discover, Barclays, Synchrony, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo, Navy Federal, TD, Truist, HSBC, M&T, PNC, Apple Card, Regions, FNBO, Upgrade, Continental Finance, Total Visa, First Progress, Avant, Petal, Citi, Santander, OpenSky, Cardless, Fifth Third, Credit One, Bank of America) and HTTP-checked all 109 detailed-entry URLs (all resolved except bot-blocked PNC/KeyBank/Mission Lane/PenFed/Huntington/Milestone/Indigo/PREMIER/CFNA/Bread, which keep the earlier headless-browser verification). Fixes: Bilt entry corrected (current Bilt Cards are issued by Column N.A. and serviced by Cardless; downgraded to a pointer entry); Cardless entry gained support phone 1-888-310-6377 and the no-check/no-phone-payment rule; Discover mail address now the Capital One PO Box 71083; Amex, Navy Federal, FNBO, Total Visa, First Progress mail addresses added; Chase hardship page, U.S. Bank autopay-cancel pointer, Upgrade pay-by-phone, Navy Federal pay-by-phone filled; OpenSky upgraded to detailed. Completeness: added 12 co-brand pointer entries missing from the map (Bank of America Atmos Rewards/Alaska, Allegiant Allways, Air France KLM, Royal Caribbean Royal ONE, Norwegian Cruise Line, Susan G. Komen; Chase Aeroplan and Instacart; U.S. Bank Kroger-family Mastercards and Korean Air SKYPASS/Aeromexico; Harley-Davidson (Comenity); Coinbase (Cardless)). Remaining limits: WebSearch budget and WebFetch quota were exhausted during this pass; Citi, Truist, Merrick, Elan, Citizens, BMO, SoFi, Chime and Fifth Third still lack public, crawlable pay/autopay how-to pages. Still missing: Citi, Truist, USAA (bot-blocked), Apple Card, Credit One, U.S. Bank (hardship page excludes cards), Aspire (site blocks readers) have no public card hardship page found; Fifth Third, Huntington, FNBO, Santander, BMO, Avant, Chime, Goldman lack a public pay-by-phone number or mail address. [dental-vision-hearing] Checked completeness against: (1) Delta Dental's 39-company network — every state/territory is mapped to a Delta company entry (DDIC/Delta Dental of California enterprise covers CA, AL, FL, GA, LA, MS, MT, NV, TX, UT, NY, PA, MD, DE, WV, DC; separate companies for the rest; MN covers NE/ND; MO covers SC; Northeast Delta covers ME/NH/VT; NJ covers CT; Moda runs OR/AK; plus Puerto Rico; Hawaii Dental Service for HI). (2) Major national dental/vision carriers and the senior-marketed direct-to-consumer brands (AARP Dental, AARP Vision, Physicians Mutual, Spirit/Denali via Ameritas, Humana, Mutual of Omaha, Cigna). (3) Largest DSOs by office count (Heartland, Aspen, PDS, Smile Brands, Affordable Care, Dental Care Alliance, Western/Sonrava, Great Expressions, Mortenson, Coast, Midwest, 42 North, Tend, Dental365). (4) Largest optical chains (National Vision, EssilorLuxottica, MyEyeDr., Visionworks, Walmart/Costco/Sam's, Clarkson, Eyemart, Stanton) and hearing networks (Amplifon/Miracle-Ear/HearUSA, Demant/HearingLife, Sonova/AudioNova, GN/Beltone/Jabra, WSA/hear.com, Starkey/Audibel, TruHearing, UHC Hearing, NationsHearing, Costco/Sam's). Method: every URL came from the biller's own sitemap or from links on fetched pages; pages were fetched this session and text-extracted. Most insurers keep premium payment, autopay and statement history behind member logins, so public 'how-to' pages exist only for some (Delta Dental of California, AARP Dental, Humana, Anthem, Aspen, Coast, Great Expressions, Midwest, MyEyeDr., HearingLife, UHC Hearing). Where links.* is null, no public page was found — the member portal is the path. RUN 2 (2026-09-29): added/upgraded billing detail using web search plus direct fetch/curl. Key finding: individual & family plans for many Delta companies (WA, CO, VA, IL, MA, MO/SC, ME/NH/VT and others) are sold and billed through DeltaDentalCoversMe.com, run by Delta Dental of Wisconsin's Wyssta Services. Pay online or by autopay in the CoversMe account, by phone at 888-899-3734, or by mail to P.O. Box 1237, Wisconsin Rapids, WI 54495. Tennessee individual plans are administered by Morgan-White; Idaho, South Dakota, North Carolina and Arizona individual premium rules were read from each company's own FAQ. Added regional DSOs (Absolute Dental NV, Perfect Teeth NM/AZ/CO, Familia, Risas, Dental Depot OK, Comfort Dental), hearing networks and programs (Audibel, EPIC Hearing, Hearing Care Solutions->TruHearing, Start Hearing, Lexie, Starkey Cares Hear Now), Dentegra, Vision Source, EyeCare Partners, and the LensCrafters Credit Card (Synchrony). Upgraded Heartland (paymydentist.com e-statements), PDS (Smile Generation MyChart), Amplifon (CardPointe pay page), Aflac, Physicians Mutual, Mutual of Omaha, Guardian Direct, Sunbit, Cherry, CareCredit (mail address), Allegro, Proceed and HDS. STILL MISSING: several sites blocked automated fetch (403/Cloudflare): Visionworks, Physicians Mutual, LensCrafters, Walmart and Warby Parker, Davis Vision, Delta Dental of Oklahoma, NationsHearing, Nano Hearing, Specsavers, Zenni. Their facts came from search snippets and are marked verified=false. JS-rendered pages whose content could not be read: VSP and EyeMed member FAQs, United Concordia help center, Guardian billing FAQ, DeltaDentalCoversMe billing pages, Delta Dental of Minnesota shop. Premium autopay cancellation steps are rarely public; for most insurers, cancel autopay in the member portal or by phone. The web-search budget ran out mid-run, so the second-tier DSOs (Sage, Smile Brands sub-brands beyond Bright Now/Castle/Monarch, Benevis, Gentle Dental West) and the state Blue Cross Blue Shield standalone dental plans are not enumerated. ROSTER BACKFILL 2026-09-30 (task roster-backfill-store-cards, edited in place; change log in categories/roster-backfill-store-cards.json): roster rows with a website went from 3 to 346 of 408; login_url 402; pay_bill 397; customer-service phone 372 (212 of those are the general Synchrony line because no brand line is published); verified roster rows 313. Method: (1) Synchrony brands matched by script to Synchrony's public marketplace brand JSON (/sites/Satellite?pagename=marketplace/categories, 712 brands with retailer shop_url, login_url and network) and the live find-account list (264 brands with brand phone and sign-in link); 154 Synchrony marketplace brand pages (synchrony.com/marketplace/partner?market=..&store=..) from the Synchrony sitemap were fetched and their titles name the brand ('<Brand> | Manage Account or Apply'), and these are now help_center_url for 107 brands; brand-specific sign-in links (client=<brand> or <brand>.syf.com) replace the generic one where Synchrony lists them; phones come from the find-account list, then the Synchrony HOME (1-844-335-5909) or Car Care (1-866-657-0376) network line, then the general line. (2) Comenity brands: each slug was confirmed by fetching the public card agreement at d.comenity.net/legaldocs/<slug>/legal-documents/cca (title names the card, invalid slugs return an untitled page); the agreement prints the brand Customer Care number and the account site comenity.net/<slug>, which are now phone_customer_service and login_url. 59 of 67 Comenity roster brands resolved. (3) Retailer websites were fetched with curl and accepted only when the title/body named the brand; about a dozen bot-blocked homepages were confirmed with WebFetch; for 30-odd Synchrony brands the website is the retailer URL Synchrony itself lists, marked verified=false because the homepage blocks scripts. PAPER STATEMENT FEE: $1.99 per paper statement on Fetti accounts since Aug 1 2024 (not in states that prohibit it) - avoid by consenting to electronic disclosures online. Optional SafeLine Account Protection Plus costs $1.89 per $100 of balance per month - can be cancelled any time (Fetti SafeLine 1-800-701-2546; Advantage 1-855-582-2128). Billing-error correspondence: Fingerhut Credit Account Services, PO Box 1250, St Cloud MN 56395. Customer Service page lists general correspondence: Fingerhut, 6250 Ridgewood Rd, St Cloud MN 56303.
